answers.core: This feature requires changes to the C# code generator, an add-on cannot change how the C# code interacts with the engine like this.
answers.workaround: This enhancement is a more advanced feature, so it likely wouldn't see much use in most games. You can, after all, simply use ToArray() to turn a Span into an array. This does unfortunately defeat the purpose of a span.

title: Add Span<> overloads to Godot methods which accept arrays
